audit_title: Intelligent Document Processing Backend Functionality Audit
scope: FATURA2-based IDP Application (FastAPI + LayoutLMv3 + Tesseract/PyMuPDF + Document QA)

1_upload_handling.name: PDF and Image Upload Handling
1_upload_handling.implementation: FastAPI endpoint POST /upload in backend/app/main.py. Validates extensions (.pdf, .png, .jpg, .jpeg), enforces 15MB limit, and rejects empty files.
1_upload_handling.test_evidence: Upload tests pass: rejected empty file (400), rejected .exe file (400), processed valid PNG and PDF files in < 0.6s.
issues_found: UploadFile in Starlette uses async stream that deadlocks in synchronous invocation loops unless handled through event loop.
MIME type detection relies purely on file extension suffix rather than magic bytes (python-magic).

2_image_preprocessing_ocr.name: Image Preprocessing & Tesseract OCR
2_image_preprocessing_ocr.implementation: backend/app/processing.py (preprocess_image, ocr_image, extract_pdf). Converts to grayscale, applies autocontrast, resizes 2x if < 1200px. PyMuPDF extracts digital text if embedded length >= 40, else renders 300 DPI image.
2_image_preprocessing_ocr.test_evidence: Digital PDF extracted in 0.013s via PyMuPDF; PNG image OCR completed in 0.343s via Tesseract with zero errors.
issues_found: Fixed 2x upscaling on already high-resolution images can result in excessive memory allocation.
Document type heuristic classifier classified sample-invoice.png as 'Unknown' due to keyword fragility.

3_layoutlmv3_loading_inference.name: LayoutLMv3 Model Loading & Inference
3_layoutlmv3_loading_inference.implementation: backend/app/models/layoutlm_extractor.py (LayoutLMv3Extractor). Loads checkpoints/layoutlmv3-fatura2 using AutoModelForTokenClassification and AutoProcessor. Word bounding boxes normalized to [0, 1000].
3_layoutlmv3_loading_inference.test_evidence: Model loaded in 0.9s; inference executed in 1.0s to 1.4s per invoice on CPU with zero crashes; extracted 4 to 8 entities per invoice.
issues_found: Sequence length truncated to 512 tokens without sliding window mechanism for very dense long documents.

4_entity_to_field_mapping.name: Mapping of Predicted Entities into Canonical Fields
4_entity_to_field_mapping.implementation: _extract_invoice in layoutlm_extractor.py maps 47 BIO labels to canonical fields (vendor_name, customer_name, invoice_number, invoice_date, total_amount, etc.).
4_entity_to_field_mapping.test_evidence: Extracted exact invoice_number ('3337'), invoice_date ('January 25, 2016'), and total_amount ('93.50') on WordPress sample invoice.
issues_found: Symmetrical header layouts can confuse SELLER and BILL_TO when explicit label anchors are absent.
Horizontal number search can concatenate prefix labels (e.g. 'Fax: [000-000-0000] CUSTOMER ID f123)' on unstructured templates).

5_line_item_extraction.name: Line-Item & Table Extraction
5_line_item_extraction.implementation: ABSENT. The canonical schema and database documents table do not have a line_items structure or table parsing logic.
5_line_item_extraction.test_evidence: TABLE, ITEM_DESCRIPTION, ITEM_QUANTITY, ITEM_UNIT_PRICE, and ITEM_TOTAL BIO labels are present in the model head but completely ignored in field output.
issues_found: No table reconstruction parser exists to group tokens by rows and columns.
No structured line-items JSON array is returned in API responses.

6_confidence_scoring.name: Confidence Score Generation & Calibration
6_confidence_scoring.implementation: backend/app/models/confidence.py and layoutlm_extractor.py. Softmax token probabilities averaged over entity spans; temperature scaling calibrator (T=1.5001); thresholds: High (>=0.85), Medium (>=0.60), Low (<0.60).
6_confidence_scoring.test_evidence: Confidence scores generated for all fields: e.g. invoice_number: 0.9978, total_amount: 0.9949; Document QA confidence levels (high/low) correctly categorized.
issues_found: Statutory regex supplement fields use hardcoded confidence scores (0.90, 0.95, 0.99) rather than model softmax.

7_postprocessing_validation.name: Post-Processing & Field Validation
7_postprocessing_validation.implementation: backend/app/main.py (_recalculate, _sync_structured_fields, _public_document). Synchronizes company_name/vendor_name; computes coverage scores.
7_postprocessing_validation.test_evidence: Field coverage correctly calculated; company_name synchronized with vendor_name in public payload.
issues_found: No mathematical cross-field validation (e.g., verifying Subtotal + Tax - Discount == Total).
Dates are stored as raw OCR string snippets without ISO-8601 normalization (YYYY-MM-DD).

8_document_qa.name: Document Question Answering
8_document_qa.implementation: backend/app/models/document_qa.py (DocumentQA). Uses impira/layoutlm-document-qa extractive QA pipeline over document image and natural language query.
8_document_qa.test_evidence: Accurately answered: 'What is the invoice number?' -> 'INV-3337' (high), 'What is the total amount?' -> '$93.50' (high).
issues_found: CRITICAL LATENCY BUG: transformers pipeline is called without local_files_only=True or HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, triggering 5 HTTP retry timeouts (~30s delay) in sandboxed/offline environments before falling back to cached weights.

9_multipage_handling.name: Multi-Page Document Handling
9_multipage_handling.implementation: backend/app/main.py (_load_document_image). Only renders doc[0] (page 0) of multi-page PDFs.
9_multipage_handling.test_evidence: For multi-page PDFs, _load_document_image returns only page 1 image; pages 2+ are completely omitted from LayoutLMv3 extraction and Document QA.
issues_found: Invoices spanning multiple pages have all subsequent page content omitted from AI extraction.
Document QA cannot answer questions about line items, terms, or signatures on page 2+.

10_error_handling_api.name: Error Handling & API Responses
10_error_handling_api.implementation: FastAPI HTTPExceptions with standard REST status codes (400, 404, 413, 500) and structured error detail payloads.
10_error_handling_api.test_evidence: Empty file returned 400; unsupported extension returned 400; non-existent document ID returned 404.
issues_found: Error detail payloads are occasionally dictionaries and occasionally strings, causing minor frontend parsing inconsistency.

prioritized_required_fixes.description: Add local_files_only=True or enforce HF_HUB_OFFLINE in document_qa.py to eliminate 30-second network retry delays on first model load.
Extend _load_document_image and extraction pipeline to iterate through all PDF pages, aggregating fields and answers across multi-page documents.
Implement tabular grouping using predicted TABLE, ITEM_DESCRIPTION, ITEM_QUANTITY, and ITEM_TOTAL labels to produce structured line-items JSON arrays.
Add date normalization (converting varied OCR date strings into ISO-8601 YYYY-MM-DD) and monetary cross-field validation.
